scheme_name: Award of Adhoc Merit Grant (Special Incentive) to Scheduled Caste Students
other_conditions: Must have secured 65% or above marks in the 10th Standard/Matriculation/SSLC Board of Examination
Must be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or continuous residence for at least five years
Must pursue higher studies in a recognized university, college or institution
benefits_summary: A one‑time cash award of ₹1,000 is given to eligible Scheduled Caste students who meet the academic criteria.
